description: This source file contains functions for processing and fitting Open Circuit Voltage (OCV) curves of battery cells, including validation, simulation, error calculation, and hierarchical parameter fitting. It is used for estimating parameters related to battery OCV curves based on user-supplied data.

methods.name: validOCV
methods.description: Checks if supplied OCV curve data has correct format, including increasing first column and realistic voltage range.

methods.name: discharge_noexcept
methods.description: Simulates a low-current discharge of a battery cell based on OCV curves, assuming uniform concentrations.

methods.name: discharge_noequal
methods.description: Simulates a battery discharge with error handling, throws exception if validation fails.

methods.name: discharge
methods.description: Performs a low-current discharge simulation, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: readOCVinput
methods.description: Reads electrode and cell OCV curves from CSV files, validates format.

methods.name: calculateError
methods.description: Calculates RMSE between user-supplied and simulated OCV curves.

methods.name: cost_OCV
methods.description: Calculates total squared error between measured and simulated OCV curves for parameter fitting.

methods.name: fitAMnAndStartingPoints
methods.description: Searches parameter space for best fit of OCV curve by varying active material and starting points.

methods.name: hierarchicalOCVfit
methods.description: Performs hierarchical search to optimize OCV fitting parameters.

methods.name: estimateOCVparameters
methods.description: Main function to estimate best-fit OCV parameters by reading data, performing hierarchical search, and outputting results.

methods.name: writeOCVParam
methods.description: Outputs best-fit parameters to CSV and console.
